notes: Committed verbatim: ru-ipv4.txt is byte-identical to the published feed, so `curl <source_url> | sha256sum` reproduces sha256 above. Copyrights.txt is the upstream notice, committed verbatim and embedded with the binary; the loader refuses a record whose notice_sha256 does not match the notice it ships. Prefix count and digest are re-derived from the committed bytes at load time and a mismatch is refused. Regenerate only with ./cmd/ru-inventory, which validates before writing; that command replaces this record and the data file by two separate renames, so an interrupted run leaves a mismatched pair that the loader refuses rather than serving — re-run the command to write both from one matching zone.
